name: kinematic-bicycle-with-understeer-v1
notes: Per-platform yaw_rate = v*tan(delta_road - delta_offset) / (L*(1 + K*v^2)). Tesla falls through to V0 because Tesla's sim psi_dot_rads IS V0 — there is no independent truth channel on that platform. Coefficients in coeffs.json fitted on all sim/segments per platform.
